items.title: Build complete source-to-Legacy feature and route acceptance matrix
items.body:
The source-commit ledger tracks commit disposition but does not prove every migrated service feature and Web/Intranet route works against production-derived local Aspire data. This is an explicit migration completion gate, not a deployment request.

Acceptance:
- Inventory each Legacy service feature, API, role, entity, background operation, and every Web/Intranet route against the latest committed original source; retain full source SHA, owning Legacy repo, main SHA, status, and exact evidence links.
- Mark unverified items pending; distinguish source retirement approvals from migrations. Do not infer feature parity from a code mapping, route alias, smoke test, or green unit suite.
- Record automated customer/employee authentication, permission, CRUD/lifecycle, validation, rollback/retry, cross-service effects, localization, responsive/browser/accessibility, and persisted-data checks as appropriate. Include safe failure/partial-failure evidence and suppress real notifications/payments/analytics in local review.
- Verify the matrix against live source and each protected Legacy main, with a check that rejects missing routes/features or unsupported completion claims. Link per-service issues and PR/main CI.
- Require signed exact-23 local data reconciliation before marking production-derived Aspire workflows accepted. Keep application deployment and traffic cutover disabled.

Historical recorded baseline: Workflows main d94eff594a9f4037d5dcf60b6ce4d531522eb5fa records 50/1096 source commits resolved and 1046 pending; Web/Intranet full authenticated acceptance is not proven.

## Source-code delivery tracking

Current source-code delivery is tracked in [Project #2](https://github.com/orgs/MALIEV-Co-Ltd/projects/2) and the [source-code completion milestone](https://github.com/MALIEV-Co-Ltd/Legacy.Maliev.Workflows/milestone/1). Use bounded service issues and PRs for current progress, owners, blockers and exact-head/exact-main validation evidence. Issue #372 is redundant and is not a migration deliverable. Previous dated checkpoints remain historical.

This issue retains its broader feature/route and production-derived Aspire acceptance requirements. Source-code delivery, data refresh and final application acceptance are separate obligations. Keep this issue open until its own acceptance is verified. Application deployment and traffic cutover remain disabled.
